messages.subject: Plotting Regression Discontinuity
parts:
In plotting regression discontinuity I would like to extrapolate the line for the treatment group forward beyond the cut point and the line for the control group backward beyond the cut point, both with a different line type that changes when the fit line reaches the cut point. In the examples below 20 is the cut point. I would like for the red line to change line type moving to the right once it passes the cut point (i.e. from solid to dashed) and the same thing to occur when the blue line passes the cut point going left. I have no idea how to do this or if it's possible.

 

Thanks for your assistance.

 

 

## Example

 

prtst<-c(3,4,7,8,9,12,15,17,18,19,7,5,10,12,16,17,15,4,9,16,22,40,30,24,25,32,53,68,29,32,24,52,69,34,55,47,33,34,37,60,58,52,50,44,44)
pstst<-c(6,5,14,12,20,30,35,40,41,44,20,10,20,33,29,34,40,12,20,43,30,45,30,45,36,44,53,75,40,41,34,55,72,40,55,50,40,41,42,65,65,55,52,47,49)

 

prtstT<-ifelse(prtst<=20,0,1)
prtst2<-prtst-21


m1<-lm(pstst~prtst2*prtstT)
summary(m1)


data <- data.frame(prtst = prtst, pstst = pstst, prtstT = prtstT, prtst2 = prtst2)

 

## Without fullrange

 

ggplot(data, aes(x = prtst, y = pstst)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = F, size = 1) +
  geom_smooth(data = subset(data, prtstT == 0), aes(prtst, pstst), method = "lm",
                          se = F, colour = "red", size = 1) +   ## Treatment group
  geom_smooth(data = subset(data, prtstT == 1), aes(prtst, pstst), method = "lm",
                           se = F, colour = "blue", size = 1) +   ## Control group
  geom_vline(x = 20, size = 1) +
  ggtitle("Regression Discontinuity Example w/o Fullrange")

 

## With fullrange where I would like the line type to change

 

ggplot(data, aes(x = prtst, y = pstst)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = F, size = 1) +
  geom_smooth(data = subset(data, prtstT == 0), aes(prtst, pstst), method = "lm",
                          se = F, colour = "red", size = 1, fullrange = T) +
  geom_smooth(data = subset(data, prtstT == 1), aes(prtst, pstst), method = "lm",
                          se = F, colour = "blue", size = 1, fullrange = T) +
  geom_vline(x = 20, size = 1) +
  ggtitle("Regression Discontinuity Example w/ Fullrange")
